_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard: categories, cardinality (max -1 = unbounded), accepted formats, tooltip help. Chimera renders and enforces; this file decides. Slot ids are what project manifests record.

slots.title: Cartridge or Famicom disk
slots.help: The game: an iNES cartridge image (.nes), or a Famicom Disk System image (.fds) - a disk makes the FDS BIOS a firmware requirement on the next wizard page, where a cartridge needs none.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the machine starts with already saved. This is the file Emulator > Export Save Data... writes - battery.sav on a cartridge with a battery, disk.sav on a Famicom Disk System, where what is saved is how the disk differs from the one loaded. It is mounted read-only and pinned by hash, and the movie cites it, so a movie that starts from a saved game is as reproducible as one that starts fresh. A machine that keeps no saves - no battery, no disk - will say so rather than load one.
